title: TelemetryMetricsRow
description: One metric point in the canonical long-format metrics table over the full available span (03 §2.2). Written by Infralume; series-distinguishing labels are folded into name so the key stays unique.

t_ns.description: Point time in ns since the Unix epoch (UTC), source time as given.

service.description: Normalised service name (lowercase, no pod hash, no underscore).

component.description: Container, pod or db name; equals service if unknown.

name.description: Original metric name after scrubbing. Adapters may rewrite it: distinguishing labels encoded as name{k=v,...} (sorted keys), _total added to monotonic OTLP sums, histograms split into <name>_count and <name>_sum (01 §3.9). No pattern.

metric_type.description: Metric type, OTLP-native when known; null when the source does not publish it.

attrs_json.description: Canonical JSON of the remaining labels, scrubbed; display only, not part of the key.

value.description: Point value; NaN and +/-inf points are dropped at ingest and rejected by the writer.

unit.description: Unit of value, e.g. bytes, s, ms; null when unknown.

source_system.description: System the metric came from; synth uses prom.
